descriptor.scene: Maya is the subject and fills the left half of the frame, mid-stride toward the camera-right along a dim pre-dawn trail, caught mid-swing clearing a hanging vine with a machete in her right hand, her closed silver laptop under her left arm as always, a small pack on her back. Her face is set with cheerful determination, jaw forward, eyes on the trail. The jungle around her is still night-blue and green, with the first warm light just reaching the leaves behind her. Her head reads about a third of the frame height: close enough to feel the effort. Sweat at her temple, leaves caught on her blazer sleeve. Keep the lower right calm: dim trail and ferns.
descriptor._caption: Maya works harder than anyone in the jungle. She is up before the light, she carries her work everywhere, and she clears more trail in a week than most camps clear in a season. Hard work is her plan. She is sure it is enough.
